title: Tardive dyskinesia review at follow-up (F1)

patient_mappings.typed_transform: mild iff effect status present AND severity mild; moderate_or_severe iff present AND severity moderate_or_severe. Present-without-severity is required-missing (needs_clarification), never defaulted to mild. AIMS totals or regional scores are never mapped.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter; clinician rating recorded with actor and timestamp per the runtime value envelope
patient_mappings.missing_policy: effect absent is handled at the gate (not_applicable), not here. Effect present with missing severity, or missing effect record, yields needs_clarification (blocks).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician records current TD as disabling; absent_assessed iff clinician records not disabling; else unknown_incomplete. Distinct from motor severity; mild motor signs may still be disabling.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until the field is reviewed and collected (permits inference).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff at least one assessed reason to consider treatment of mild TD is recorded (patient preference, associated impairment, or psychosocial impact); absent_assessed iff clinician records none; else unknown_incomplete.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).

allowed_source_paths: encounters.draft_data.td_assessment.attribution_context (PROPOSED, not collected: movement_pattern, persistence_weeks, exposure_history, onset_timing, alternative_explanations)
patient_mappings.typed_transform: antipsychotic_associated_assessed iff clinician records persistent TD associated with antipsychotic exposure after pattern/persistence/exposure/onset review with no unresolved alternative; alternative_or_unresolved iff an alternative explanation is recorded or the course is withdrawal-emergent/spontaneous pending reassessment; else unknown_incomplete. Never inferred from severity, medication presence, or any AIMS value.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter for the assessment; historical_interval for exposure/onset dates where recorded
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference; renders assess_diagnosis_and_attribution).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff dyskinesia began or increased around antipsychotic dose reduction; absent_assessed iff clinician records no such link; else unknown_incomplete. Prompts longitudinal review only, never an exclusion or waiting period.
patient_mappings.time_window: current_encounter assessment of recent medication-change linkage
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields unknown_incomplete with disclosure until reviewed and collected (permits inference).

patient_mappings.typed_transform: present iff clinician records constant movement with gagging/choking or breathing impact; absent_assessed iff clinician records none. Deterministic urgent flag fires from this saved value without waiting for any model output.
patient_mappings.missing_policy: field absent yields needs_clarification (required input blocks) until reviewed and collected.

applicability.expression_language: allowlisted conjunction of == comparisons on encounter.kind and the FR-21 effect status only; no arithmetic, no function calls, no note access (proposed for owner review; the S25 allowlist parser is authoritative)
required_fields: absence of conflicting values for mapped nodes
applicability.unknown_policy: effect absent yields not_applicable with reason (no inference, no CPTs, no posterior; a false gate is never a negative posterior). Effect not_assessed, missing, or conflicting yields needs_clarification and stops later questions; saving corrected input creates a new run. Missing required non-gate input (severity when present, urgent concern) yields needs_clarification. Missing optional input (disabling, mild-consideration, attribution, dose link) leaves that node as unknown_incomplete; inference proceeds and the template renders an unknown disclosure.

cpt_contract.row_order: child state fastest; last declared parent next; first parent slowest
cpt_contract.validation: one table per node in declared order; exact node/parent/state identity and order; no extra fields; finite numbers in [0,100]; each row sums to 100 within 1e-6; reject missing/duplicate/extra rows, strings/booleans/null, nonfinite, out-of-range, wrong sums; never normalize/clip/repair

evidence_mappings.evidence: mapped mild/moderate_or_severe state as hard evidence when effect present; missing blocks before inference
mapped state, including unknown_incomplete as an observed state

mapped present/absent_assessed state as hard evidence when assessed; missing blocks before inference

impossible_evidence_policy: fail with explicit error; never soften or approximate. All declared states (including unknown_incomplete where declared) are possible, so impossibility arises only from schema violations (undeclared node/state, conflicting evidence on one node).
reviewed_result_mapping: posterior branch rendered as review prompt only; maximum posterior is not a recommendation rule; deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs shown first and never waits for LLM; longitudinal and urgent posteriors always rendered alongside the indication branch; unknown_disclosure always appended; needs_clarification branch on required missing/conflict; not_applicable branch on gate-absent

context_output_resource_limits.note: Limits are proposed engineering ceilings for review; final values set after measuring admitted models per plan 8.3. Full-CPT payload must fit or admission is rejected; no silent truncation.

engine_configuration.elimination_order: deterministic pinned order with deterministic tie-breaking
engine_configuration.note: Pinned engine/runtime recorded at admission in S39; replay reads stored effective CPTs/evidence/query without provider calls.
